services.name: Surf Fishing
services.desc: You’ve probably heard of surf fishing, sometimes called beach fishing, and maybe even tried fishing before from a beach. Whatever your level of surf fishing experience may be, whether you’re a first timer or an old pro, Captains Corey and Melissa will cater to your skill level, share their techniques and make your surf fishing experience in Daytona Beach a memorable one. Depending on where the fish are biting best, we’ll meet you at one of the hottest fishing spots on one of the many beautiful stretches of beach in the Daytona Beach area.
